record the exact model-visible screenshot outcome without using hidden activity or UI-tree state

paired_decision_gates.success_target: A2 full success count must exceed A1's 5/19 to claim accuracy improvement
paired_decision_gates.cost_target: A2 total tokens and wall-clock time should both be lower than A1
paired_decision_gates.memory_attribution: an improved task needs nonempty memory reads before the changed decision; guard-only interventions cannot be credited to memory
paired_decision_gates.guard_attribution: report guard triggers, blocks, cost stops, and affected tasks separately
paired_decision_gates.negative_result: if either primary target fails, preserve and report the frozen negative result without tuning this run
